calendarNotes: CFISD lists October 9 and March 12 as teacher work days, student holidays, and possible inclement-weather make-up days. November 3 is a teacher work day, student holiday, and possible school-closure make-up day. Any of these dates should be rechecked after a district closure.

customSections.label: What’s New for 2026–27
customSections.content:
The biggest calendar change is October. CFISD students have a full fall break from October 12–16, replacing the two-day October 13–14 break on the 2025–26 calendar. The first and last days of school also move one day earlier.

The Board approved the calendar on November 10, 2025, after the Districtwide Educational Improvement Council developed options and the district received more than 15,000 community survey responses. October 9 and March 12 are currently student holidays and teacher work days, but CFISD may use either date as an inclement-weather make-up day. CFISD’s District of Innovation status allows the school year to begin before the fourth Monday in August.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Cy-Fair ISD start school in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The first day of school for CFISD students is Wednesday, August 12, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: Does CFISD have a fall break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. CFISD Fall Break runs Monday, October 12 through Friday, October 16, 2026. October 9 is currently a student holiday and possible inclement-weather make-up day, so check district announcements before planning around the longer October closure.

calendarFaqs.q: When do CFISD students return after winter break?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break ends Friday, January 1, 2027. Monday, January 4 is a professional day, so students return Tuesday, January 5.

calendarFaqs.q: Which CFISD student holidays are designated as possible make-up days?
calendarFaqs.a: October 9, 2026 and March 12, 2027 are designated as possible inclement-weather make-up days. November 3, 2026 is listed as a possible school-closure make-up day. Check CFISD announcements after any closure.

calendarFaqs.q: Where can I download the official 2026–27 CFISD calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: CFISD publishes the official 2026–27 calendar PDF on its district calendar page. The MySchoolDates .ics download is a separate one-time calendar import based on the dates reviewed for this page.

sourceReviewDetailsTitle: How we verified the CFISD calendar
sourceReviewDetails: We checked CFISD’s official one-page calendar for the first and last days of school, holidays, professional days, teacher work days, make-up day designations, breaks, and grading-period dates.
The Board announcement confirms the November 10, 2025 approval date, the DEIC process, more than 15,000 completed surveys, and the conditional status of October 9 and March 12.

For convenience, we show when students return after each major break. Those dates are based on CFISD’s published break endings and adjacent professional days; they are not listed as separate events on the official PDF.
The .ics download uses the same calendar dates reviewed for this page.
sourceNextReviewText: We’ll review this page again if CFISD replaces the calendar PDF, revises the schedule, or activates one of the designated make-up days.
